summary: Build an English-only iOS (iPhone) app called “Maleeha Focus” for a Pharm-D student: to-do + study manager + motivation, including a special “For Maleeha” section from her brother Chotu, with focus timer, attendance tracker, quotes, widgets, iOS-style theme, offline local storage, reminders, and optional Face ID/passcode lock.
architectural_notes: English-only iPhone (iOS) app; iOS-style UI with dark mode support.
Offline-first with persistent on-device local storage (data remains after app close).
Use iOS notifications for task reminders.
Optional Face ID / passcode lock for app access.
Home screen widgets for today’s tasks, focus timer, and quick add.
Focus mode includes 45-min timer + short break + iOS-style progress ring; integrates Do Not Disturb during focus.
imageRequirements:
## Edit Images
- Update the app icon to match the provided logo idea: open book + small pharmacy leaf, soft peach & lavender gradient, minimal flower symbol, rounded friendly iOS icon style (app-icon.dim_512x512.png > app-icon.dim_512x512.png)

existing_features.title: Update all app naming and copy from the current “Taruba Focus / CEC” branding to “Maleeha Focus” for a Pharm-D student, ensuring all user-facing text is English only.
Replace the existing task categories and subjects with the requested Pharm-D categories and subjects, and ensure category selection + filtering continues to work across the app.

Implement/rename the special category section to “For Maleeha 🌸” with the requested preset tasks, a flower completion indicator, and a soft pastel accent applied only within this category’s UI elements.

Update the daily quote generator to use exactly the 20 provided “from Chotu” quotes (verbatim), with random selection and a manual refresh action, while keeping the existing “daily persistence” behavior.

Apply the specified iOS-style theme palette across the app (light + dark mode), including updating global theme colors to match: Primary #FFD6E0, Secondary #D4C1FF, Background #FFF6F9, Success #C8FFD4, Text #2F2F2F.
Ensure typography matches the request: use iOS-system style for general UI (San Francisco-like) and render quotes in a soft handwritten style.

Confirm the Home screen layout matches the requested structure for “Maleeha Focus”: top date + quote card, middle category cards, bottom floating add button, and ensure the displayed date is today’s date.
Keep the existing task CRUD behavior (add title/description/time, edit, delete, mark completed) and ensure tasks persist locally/offline after closing and reopening.

Maintain the focus system as a 45-minute focus timer with a short break after completion, with an iOS-style progress ring animation, and ensure the “Do Not Disturb during focus” request is represented as in-app distraction reduction (without claiming OS-level DND control).

Update the Attendance Tracker area to align with the Pharm-D context (copy/labels), while preserving: subject list management, present/absent marking, attendance percentage, and the monthly calendar view.
Add an “App Store description” section in Settings (or an About section) that displays the provided description text verbatim in English.

new_feature_requests.summary: Core to-do tasks: add/edit/delete/complete tasks with title, description, time; persist in iOS local storage; show today's date on home

Category system with predefined categories and Pharm-D study subjects (Pharmaceutics, Medicinal Biochemistry, Human Anatomy & Physiology, Organic Chemistry, Inorganic Chemistry, Remedial Maths) plus Personal, Health & Routine, and For Maleeha
45-minute focus system: focus timer, short break, iOS-style progress ring animation, and Do Not Disturb during focus
Attendance tracker: manage subjects list, mark present/absent, compute attendance percentage, and show monthly calendar view (Apple style)
Special 'For Maleeha' section: preset supportive tasks, flower icon on completion, and soft pastel accent styling limited to this section
Daily quote generator (random) using the provided 20 quotes from Chotu; display in a quote card
iOS-style theme and UI layout: pastel color palette, iOS system font + handwritten style for quotes, date+quote card, category cards, floating add button, and dark mode support
iOS widgets: home screen widget(s) for today's tasks, 45-min timer, and quick add task
iOS requirements: offline-first, lightweight/smooth, data persists after closing, notification reminders, optional Face ID/passcode lock
Create App Store description text per provided draft
App icon/logo direction: open book + small pharmacy leaf, peach/lavender gradient, minimal flower symbol, rounded iOS icon style
